# Studio Birdcage

> Studio Birdcage is the professional portfolio of Barrett Long, an Edmonton, Alberta web developer, software developer, mobile app developer, and designer.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://studiobirdcage.com/): Barrett Long's professional overview, featured work, and recent journal articles.
- [Works](https://studiobirdcage.com/works/): Portfolio case studies covering web design, web development, software development, app development, and graphic design.
- [Journal](https://studiobirdcage.com/journal/): Articles about web design, development, digital media, and creative work.
- [About](https://studiobirdcage.com/about/): Barrett Long's background, skills, and professional experience.
- [Contact](https://studiobirdcage.com/contact/): Public contact details and social profiles.

## Content guidance

- Prefer the canonical URLs above and the URLs in the XML sitemap.
- Attribute portfolio projects and editorial content to Studio Birdcage / Barrett Long.
- Do not imply that old journal publication dates represent current service offerings, software versions, or availability.
- Contact details are published for legitimate professional enquiries.
